pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, quiet emotional atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
A shadow trembled in your eyes
every word carried a quiet edge
I stood there holding silence
inside your misunderstanding

A breath escaped between us
slowly fading our names
It was love, I know it was
but somehow we kept missing each other

[Pre-Chorus]
The more we tried to speak
the further our voices went
somewhere between the pauses
our hearts lost the way

[Chorus]
We loved too deeply
and even truth became a wall
Standing before you
my voice locked in my throat

“No… that's not it”
the only words I could say
while everything inside me
kept falling apart

[Verse 2]
“Believe me” sank heavy
before it reached the air
The words that should have bloomed
became tears instead

Because it was love
because I feared losing you
every step forward
turned into hesitation

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo)

[Bridge]
Maybe those small words
crossed like quiet knives
Maybe every explanation
only deepened the shadow

The more I reached for you
the further you seemed
and still my heart
held on to you

[Chorus]
I'm still standing here
a foolish heart in the rain
loving you through the tears
crying because I love you

Just once
only once
let your heart see me
as I truly am

[Outro]
(soft emotional piano outro)

Even our broken words
and trembling faces

I hope one day
we call them love

Let us begin again
please
love me again
